speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location, nature, and onset of your sudden abdominal pain, and let me know if you have any history of similar episodes or relevant medical conditions.

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia. The patient's history of recent myocardial infarction, sudden onset periumbilical pain, and bloody stools are classic signs of intestinal ischemia due to thromboembolism. I am requesting immediate CT Angiography of the abdomen and pelvis to confirm the diagnosis.
